text.en: Sperm and egg cells are produced on the same kind of ongoing schedule -- men make new sperm continuously and women make new eggs continuously too, just less often -- in reality nearly all of a female's oocytes are already present at birth and simply mature/are released over the reproductive lifespan (no new oocytes are ever produced), while spermatogenesis is a continuous production process starting at puberty -- a fundamental asymmetry in gamete-production timelines, not a difference of degree.
text.et: Spermi- ja munarakud toodetakse sama pideva ajakava järgi -- mehed toodavad pidevalt uusi spermirakke ja naised toodavad pidevalt uusi munarakke, lihtsalt harvemini -- tegelikult on peaaegu kõik naise munarakud juba sündides olemas ning need lihtsalt küpsevad/vabanevad üle reproduktiivea (uusi munarakke ei toodeta kunagi juurde), samas kui spermatogenees on pidev tootmisprotsess, mis algab puberteedist -- fundamentaalne asümmeetria sugurakkude tootmisajakavades, mitte astmeline erinevus.
